quarterly_data.quarter: Cohere press release: Introducing Rerank 5: precise, efficient enterprise (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cohere released Rerank 5 (Pro and Fast tiers), joining Embed 5 and Parse 5 in its latest generation of search models, generally available today on the Cohere API and Model Vault, Microsoft Foundry, Amazon SageMaker, private VPC / on-premises deployment and to all North users; API pricing is $0.05 per 1M tokens for Pro and $0.02 for Fast. New Context Focus returns the most relevant passages within each document; Cohere says Rerank 5 Pro leads on major public benchmarks (company claim).
